snapshots.title: Windows 64-bit
snapshots.requirement: Windows 11 or Windows 10 on a 64-bit Intel or AMD processor. This is the right choice for almost every Windows PC.

snapshots.title: Windows on ARM
snapshots.requirement: Windows 11 on an ARM processor, such as a Snapdragon-based Copilot+ PC. Choose the 64-bit build instead if you are unsure.

snapshots.title: Windows 32-bit
snapshots.requirement: A 32-bit installation of Windows. Almost no current PC needs this, so choose the 64-bit build unless you know yours is 32-bit.

snapshots.title: macOS on Intel
snapshots.requirement: A Mac with an Intel processor. If your Mac has Apple silicon, use the Apple silicon build instead.

snapshots.title: macOS on Apple silicon
snapshots.requirement: A Mac with an M1 processor or newer. This is the right choice for every Mac sold since late 2020.

snapshots.title: Linux 64-bit
snapshots.requirement: A 64-bit Linux distribution with a desktop environment. Your package manager may already offer a more convenient Chromium.

snapshots.title: Android
snapshots.requirement: Android 10 or newer. The file is an APK you install yourself, which Android asks you to allow the first time.
